name: What is hydro jetting and how does it work?

mainEntity.name: What is hydro jetting and how does it work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Hydro jetting is a powerful drain cleaning method that uses high-pressure water streams to clear blockages and build-up from pipes. Water is propelled at up to 4,000 PSI through a specialized nozzle, which dislodges grease, roots, sediment, and other debris, flushing it completely out of your plumbing system. This differs from traditional snaking, which typically only punches a hole through a blockage, leaving residue behind. For homes in Las Vegas and surrounding areas, hydro jetting is particularly effective for recurring clogs caused by hard water mineral deposits common in the region.
acceptedAnswer.description: Hydro jetting uses high-pressure water to thoroughly clean pipes and remove blockages, including grease, roots, and hard water deposits.
